'''Carrie Savage''' is a voice actor for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Savage was born on April 8, 1980 in Atlanta, Georgia. She first worked on the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|BW}} where she voiced [[Christie]]. In addition to her voice work, Savage has also worked as voice director on several series.
